newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee drifts lower, activity thin before NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee drifts lower, activity thin before NY.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures headed lower in a thin start to the week's trading and were reluctant to stray too far from opening levels before the New York open, traders said on Monday.
"I think quiet would be a good word to describe it -- it's one of those mornings," said one.
"There's no great feeling to get involved and do anything before New York opens."
Traders cited a mixed bag of players with long liquidation causing nearby contracts to weaken, but at the midday break all traded positions had managed to claw off session lows.
July stood $17 lower at $1,823 and September was down $20 at $1,840. Volume was thin at just 621 lots.
Technical analysts said London coffee was likely to trade sideways, with benchmark September staying in a range between $1,700 and $2,000 in the near term.
